title: The Stalker Shelter
description: Enter the world, farm, and die... This mode is pure horror, very simple: you see it, it sees you, and you're scared.
body:
👁️ Key Features:
Atmospheric & Visual Horror: Pitch-black nights, and dynamic lighting that makes exploring terrifying. Your flashlight is your only lifeline.

Immersive Audio Overhaul: Every sound has been reworked to build tension. Distant footsteps, echoing screeches, and metallic groans will make you second-guess every single movement.

Unforgiving Survival: Resources are scarce, and injuries are devastating. Manage your gear meticulously, or find yourself defenseless at the worst possible moment.

Adaptive Threats: Mutants and anomalies don't just wander—they stalk you from the darkness, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
